Notes

Public data only — no analytics grant for this channel yet, so there are no retention curves, first-28-day windows or written findings here. Outlier scores below divide LIFETIME views by the median of each upload's nearest neighbours by publish date, so 1.00x means typical for this channel AT THAT TIME rather than against a catalogue-wide average that a growing channel would make meaningless. It is still not the same measure as the first-28-day score used on analysed channels: a lifetime count rewards an older video for having been around longer. All 943 produced long-form uploads on the channel are here.

What to do next

Ordered by viewers at stake. Every chart says what kind of evidence it is: hover the badge. An observed figure is counted, not compared, and claims no cause. A correlation means two things move together on this channel, which is not the same as one causing the other.

  1. 1 Measured ~10K viewers at stake

    Publish every 3 days, even when the video is smaller than you wanted.

    Uploads on the usual rhythm beat ones that broke it.

    What would make this wrong

    Cadence and effort move together: a broken schedule often means a harder video.

  2. 2 This channel ~9K viewers at stake

    Stop shipping "___ Fishing For Anything That Bites", or repackage the premise.

    This shape underperforms the channel's own median.

    What would make this wrong

    A weak format is not always a weak idea — it can be a weak package on a sound premise. Check the thumbnails and titles before retiring the shape itself. Nothing we have measured across channels tests this one; it is your own catalogue talking.

Also checked, no action needed (1)
  • Formats: 9 run between 0.75x and 1.30x. Working as intended.

Built from 40 recent uploads. NO retention data, so nothing here is about what happens INSIDE a video — only about what the channel publishes, how often, and how those uploads performed. "Viewers at stake" is an estimate, not a forecast.

The opening, the ending and runtime-against-hold could not be checked: they need a retention curve, and 0 of this channel's uploads carry one (6 are needed). That needs an Analytics grant on the channel, or a Studio session that can read it.

1 of 2 actions rest on this channel alone. No cross-channel measurement backs them yet.

Video wall

Each badge is the video's outlier score — its first-28-day views against the median of the uploads nearest it in time. 1.00× is typical for this channel at that point; 2×+ is a breakout; below 0.5× underperformed. Compared against contemporaries rather than the whole catalogue, because a video from before the channel grew would otherwise always look like a failure. Median, not average, so one breakout can't drag the baseline.

Formats

The repeatable shapes this channel publishes, written as templates. A format is a shape a viewer recognises as “another one of those” — so two videos belong together when they make the same promise, even if they share no words. Ordered by how well the shape performs against the channel’s own median, not by how often it is used: a format shipped twenty times that underperforms is a habit, not a strength. The multiplier is the group’s median outlier score, measured against each video’s contemporaries. A shape marked era-bound ran in a block — most of its neighbouring uploads share the same shape, so its score compares it against itself and cannot be read as performance. Interleaving two formats over the same months is what makes them comparable.
